questions.q: The chemical formula of water is?
questions.exp: The chemical formula of water is H₂O. Each water molecule consists of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom bonded together.

questions.q: Which gas is known as 'laughing gas'?
questions.exp: Nitrous oxide (N₂O) is known as 'laughing gas'. It is used as an anesthetic in medicine and dentistry. Inhaling it causes temporary euphoria and laughter.

questions.q: The atomic number of Carbon is?
questions.exp: Carbon has an atomic number of 6, meaning it has 6 protons in its nucleus. Its atomic mass is approximately 12 amu.

questions.q: Who is known as the Father of Chemistry?
questions.exp: Antoine Lavoisier is known as the Father of Modern Chemistry. He discovered the role of oxygen in combustion and developed the law of conservation of mass.

questions.q: pH of a neutral solution is?
questions.exp: A neutral solution (like pure water) has a pH of 7. Solutions with pH < 7 are acidic, and pH > 7 are basic/alkaline. The pH scale ranges from 0 to 14.
Au is the chemical symbol for Gold, derived from the Latin word 'Aurum'. Gold is a precious metal with atomic number 79 and is known for its malleability and conductivity.

questions.q: The process of conversion of sugar into alcohol is called?
questions.exp: Fermentation is the process by which sugar is converted into alcohol and carbon dioxide by microorganisms like yeast. It is used in making beer, wine, and bread.

questions.q: Which gas is used in fire extinguishers?
questions.exp: Carbon dioxide (CO₂) is commonly used in fire extinguishers. It smothers the fire by displacing oxygen and cooling the burning material.

questions.q: The chemical formula of common salt is?
questions.exp: Common salt (table salt) has the chemical formula NaCl (Sodium Chloride). It consists of sodium (Na) and chlorine (Cl) ions in a 1:1 ratio.

questions.q: Rusting of iron is an example of?
questions.exp: Rusting of iron is a chemical change (oxidation). Iron reacts with oxygen and moisture to form iron oxide (Fe₂O₃·nH₂O), commonly known as rust. This is an irreversible process.
